idea-plugin.name: Phantom Bytecode Viewer
idea-plugin.description: Shows the bytecode of a compiled Java or Kotlin class in the ASM format: select a .java, .kt or .class file, or put the caret in a class, and open View | Show Bytecode. The Bytecode tool window follows the editor's caret and selection to the matching instructions, and can hide debug information. Compile first for source files. Ported from the IntelliJ Community Bytecode Viewer (Apache 2.0) so it updates without a new Phantom build; turn the bundled Bytecode Viewer off if your Phantom still bundles it.
